# Easy Garage Cleaning

Business Name: Easy Garage Cleaning LLC
What We Do: Garage reclaiming specialist — cleanouts, junk removal, organization, and item pickup in Northern Colorado
Owner: Zac Bezenek (CSU student-run, Fort Collins native)
Cities Served: Fort Collins (Old Town, Midtown, Fossil Creek, Harmony corridor, South College), Loveland (Centerra, Mariana Butte), Windsor (Raindance, Pelican Lakes), Timnath, Wellington, Severance, LaPorte
Phone: (970) 999-1818
Email: contact@easygaragecleaning.com
Website: https://easygaragecleaning.com
Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM
Geo: 40.585260, -105.084419 (Fort Collins, CO)

Pricing Summary: Flat-rate only — single-item pickup $99–150, small loads $250–400, standard garage cleanouts $400–650, large/estate $650+. Photo quotes in 5 minutes. No hidden fees. Only pay after approving quote.

Positioning: "Garage reclaiming" not generic junk hauling. Tagline: Park in your garage again. Reclaim usable space.
